name: voicestudio
description: VoiceStudio (AGPL-3.0) local speech/voice MCP. Install separately: https://voicestudio.sh

name: photocraft
description: PhotoCraft headless MCP (Apache-2.0). Needs the photocraft-cli binary.

name: rea
description: Reverse Engineer Anything (morluto/rea, MIT) - binary/app analysis MCP. Opt-in: set REA_MCP=1.

name: fraymus-portal
description: Fraymus OS One studio through the Fraymus Portal MCP endpoint (Fraymus-OS-One branch fraymus-portal). Opt-in: set PORTAL_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4191/mcp. Agents normally use the built-in portal_call tools; this adds the same tools as fraymus-portal__<tool>.
